name: fleet-optimize
description: Optimize scorable artifacts with GEPA Omni orchestration and GEPA's latest parallel-proposal workflow.

interface.longDescription: Fleet Optimize ships two skills. GEPA Omni runs standalone, fixed-portfolio, and adaptive workflows across reflective GEPA, AutoResearch, Meta-Harness, and Best-of-N. The parallel-proposal skill uses the latest upstream GEPA API for P×N sampling, concurrent evaluation, selection strategies, and optional batch evaluation. GEPA Omni engines use one OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions runner without local shell or filesystem tools. Runner profiles are compatibility metadata, not Codex, Pi, or Claude CLI sessions.
defaultPrompt: Optimize this candidate against my evaluator with Omni
Optimize this candidate with parallel GEPA proposals
Help me write a feedback-rich GEPA evaluator
